description: Associations between human genetic variants and genes supported by molecular QTL signals, Locus-to-Gene predictions or ClinVar gene attributions. Gene-specific predicted consequences, amino-acid changes, distances, SIFT assessments and AlphaMissense assessments annotate these associations. Evidence retains allele specificity even when several alleles share a Variant node.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the association or its properties were last changed.

common_properties.name: ot_qtl_n_studies
common_properties.description: Number of distinct supporting QTL study identifiers.
common_properties.notes: 0 when the source does not support the edge.

common_properties.name: ot_l2g_n_studies
common_properties.description: Number of distinct supporting L2G study identifiers.
common_properties.notes: 0 when the source does not support the edge.

common_properties.name: ot_clinvar_n_assertions
common_properties.description: Number of distinct supporting ClinVar RCV identifiers.
common_properties.notes: 0 when the source does not support the edge.

source_contributions.scope: Lead variants of expression, splicing, transcript usage, single-cell expression and protein QTL credible sets; no threshold. Genes must be represented in SPOKE.
source_contributions.description: One evidence entry represents one credible set. Biosample names and expanded QTL type labels describe the molecular context.

properties.name: ot_qtl_study_locus_ids
properties.description: Open Targets credible-set identifiers.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_study_ids
properties.description: Identifiers of the supporting QTL studies.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_projects
properties.description: Study project names, such as GTEx-v10.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_types
properties.description: QTL type: expression QTL, splicing QTL, transcript usage QTL, single-cell expression QTL or protein QTL.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_biosample_ids
properties.description: Biosample identifiers as CURIEs.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_biosample_names
properties.description: Biosample names.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_variant_ids
properties.description: Lead variant allele identifiers.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_p_values
properties.description: QTL association p-values.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_betas
properties.description: QTL association beta values.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_standard_errors
properties.description: Standard errors of the QTL association estimates.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_lead_pips
properties.description: Posterior probabilities of the lead variants in their credible sets.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_log10_bfs
properties.description: Credible-set log10 Bayes factors.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_finemapping_methods
properties.description: Fine-mapping methods.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_qtl_is_trans
properties.description: Whether the QTL is trans.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. [assumption] missing → false.

source_contributions.scope: GWAS credible-set lead variants with L2G score ≥ 0.5. Variants must also have a disease association, QTL gene association or pharmacogenomic compound association.
source_contributions.description: One evidence entry represents one credible-set–gene prediction. Trait identifiers retain the original study diseases or traits.

properties.name: ot_l2g_study_ids
properties.description: GWAS study identifiers for the credible sets.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_l2g_variant_ids
properties.description: Lead variant allele identifiers.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_l2g_scores
properties.description: Locus-to-Gene prediction scores; only scores ≥ 0.5 are included.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_l2g_trait_ids
properties.description: Study disease or trait identifiers as CURIEs, including measurement traits.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|".

properties.name: ot_l2g_mean_score
properties.description: Mean of the L2G prediction scores.

source_contributions.scope: Germline and somatic ClinVar assertions for variants with a disease or pharmacogenomic compound association. Only “not provided” clinical significance values are excluded; no review-status filter.
source_contributions.description: One evidence entry represents one ClinVar assertion attributing the variant to the gene. The assertion’s disease need not be represented in SPOKE.

properties.name: ot_clinvar_rcv_ids
properties.description: ClinVar RCV assertion identifiers.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_clinvar_clinical_significances
properties.description: Clinical significance values, excluding “not provided”.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|".

properties.name: ot_clinvar_directions_on_target
properties.description: Reported direction on the gene, such as LoF.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

source_contributions.scope: Annotations on associations supported by QTL, L2G or ClinVar; they do not independently establish associations. Open Targets transcript consequences can cover genes within 500 kb of a variant.
source_contributions.description: One annotation entry represents an allele with a predicted consequence on the associated gene. SIFT and AlphaMissense assessments refer to that gene. These annotations carry no additional sources tag.

properties.name: ot_vep_variant_ids
properties.description: Variant allele identifiers for the gene-specific consequence annotations.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_vep_consequences
properties.description: Sequence Ontology labels for predicted functional consequences on this gene.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|".

properties.name: ot_vep_amino_acid_changes
properties.description: Predicted amino-acid changes.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_vep_distances
properties.description: Distance from the gene footprint; 0 means the variant lies within the gene.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_sift_assessments
properties.description: SIFT assessments for the variant allele on this gene.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.

properties.name: ot_alphamissense_assessments
properties.description: AlphaMissense assessments for the variant allele on this gene.
properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index *i* refers to the same entry.
